rules: Two topics per day (07:00, 19:00 IST), never reused. status: '' = not yet made, 'rendered YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' = video pushed, 'scheduled YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (...)' or 'posted ...' = used.

topics.title: Odd numbers secretly build squares
topics.hook: Add 1+3+5+...+99 in 3 seconds?

topics.title: Gauss's 1 to 100 trick
topics.hook: Add 1 to 100 in 10 seconds?
topics.wow: Two staircases make an n x (n+1) rectangle

topics.title: Pythagoras without algebra
topics.fact: a^2+b^2=c^2 via rearranging 4 right triangles inside an (a+b) square
topics.hook: Why does 3,4,5 make a right angle?
topics.wow: Same 4 triangles, two arrangements: leftover area c^2 = a^2+b^2

topics.title: Every triangle hides a straight line
topics.fact: Interior angles of any triangle sum to 180 degrees
topics.hook: Draw ANY triangle. Its angles always add to the same number.
topics.wow: Tear off 3 corners, they form a straight line
topics.ending: What do the angles of a quadrilateral add to? (360)

topics.title: Why the circle area is pi r squared
topics.fact: Slice a circle into wedges, rearrange to a near-rectangle r by pi r
topics.hook: Where does pi r^2 come from?
topics.wow: Wedges straighten into a rectangle as slices -> infinity
topics.ending: Circumference is 2 pi r. Why does area lose the 2?

topics.title: 0.999... equals 1
topics.hook: Is 0.999... smaller than 1?
topics.wow: Number line zoom: no number fits between them

topics.title: Infinite halves fit in one square
topics.hook: Can infinitely many pieces add up to just 1?

topics.title: Fibonacci squares make a golden spiral
topics.fact: Ratios of consecutive Fibonacci numbers approach phi = 1.6180339...
topics.hook: 1,1,2,3,5,8... what's hiding in these numbers?

topics.title: Walk around any polygon: you turn 360 degrees
topics.fact: Sum of exterior angles of a convex polygon = 360
topics.hook: Turn at every corner of a shape. How much did you turn?
topics.wow: Polygon shrinks to a point; angles become a full turn

topics.title: (a+b)^2 is not a^2+b^2
topics.fact: (a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2 area model
topics.hook: Is (a+b)^2 equal to a^2+b^2?

topics.title: Cut a square, get a rectangle
topics.hook: Multiply 51 x 49 in your head?

topics.title: Pascal's triangle adds to powers of 2
topics.fact: Row n sums to 2^n; entries are binomial coefficients
topics.hook: Add every number in a row of this triangle...

topics.title: Where the sine wave comes from
topics.fact: A point on the unit circle; its height over angle traces sin(theta)
topics.hook: Why does sine look like a wave?
topics.wow: Circle unrolls into the sine curve; cosine is the same wave shifted 90 deg

topics.title: Monty Hall: switching wins 2/3
topics.fact: Switching wins with probability 2/3
topics.hook: 3 doors, 1 car. Should you switch?
topics.wow: Simulation of many games converges to 66.7%

topics.title: 23 people, 50% chance of a shared birthday
topics.fact: P(shared) for 23 people = 50.7% (365 days, uniform)
topics.hook: How many people for a 50% birthday match?
topics.wow: Pair count 253 grows fast; curve crosses 50% at 23

topics.title: Find pi by throwing random dots
topics.fact: Fraction of random points in quarter circle -> pi/4
topics.hook: Can random dots calculate pi?
topics.ending: How many dots for 2 correct decimals?

topics.title: The sieve that catches primes
topics.fact: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 100: 25 primes
topics.hook: How do you find every prime below 100?

topics.title: The digit-sum test for 9
topics.fact: A number is divisible by 9 iff its digit sum is; 10 = 9+1
topics.hook: Is 738,261 divisible by 9 without dividing?

topics.title: Why you can't divide by zero
topics.fact: 1/x grows without bound as x->0+ and -> -infinity as x->0-; no single value
topics.hook: What is 1 divided by 0?
topics.wow: Graph of 1/x splits in two directions

topics.title: Why a triangle is half base x height
topics.fact: Two copies form a parallelogram of area bh
topics.hook: Why the 1/2 in triangle area?

topics.title: A cone is exactly 1/3 of a cylinder
topics.fact: V_cone = (1/3) pi r^2 h
topics.hook: How many cones fill a cylinder?
topics.wow: Three cones pour into one cylinder
topics.ending: What fraction of a cube is a square pyramid? (1/3)

topics.title: Interior angles of any polygon
topics.fact: Sum = (n-2) x 180 via triangulation from one vertex
topics.hook: Angles in a 10-sided shape add to?
topics.wow: Triangles fan out from one corner

topics.title: Where e = 2.718 comes from
topics.fact: (1+1/n)^n -> e = 2.71828... as compounding gets more frequent
topics.hook: 100% interest, compounded forever: do you get infinite money?

topics.title: e^(i pi) + 1 = 0 as a rotation
topics.fact: e^(i theta) = cos theta + i sin theta; theta = pi gives -1
topics.hook: How can e, i, pi, 1 and 0 fit in one equation?

topics.title: 11 x 11, 111 x 111, ... a palindrome pyramid
topics.hook: What is 111,111,111 squared?
topics.wow: The pattern climbs to 9 and comes back

topics.title: Multiply by 11 in one second
topics.fact: For 2-digit ab: a (a+b) b with carry; 72x11=792, 85x11=935
topics.hook: Can you do 72 x 11 instantly?

topics.title: A times table draws a heart
topics.fact: Connect k to 2k mod N on a circle: cardioid
topics.hook: What shape hides in the 2 times table?

topics.title: Infinite perimeter, finite area
topics.fact: Koch snowflake perimeter x4/3 each step -> infinity; area -> 8/5 of original triangle
topics.hook: Can a shape have an infinite edge but fit on paper?
topics.wow: Perimeter counter runs away while area settles
topics.ending: Can you draw a curve that fills a square?

topics.title: Random dots draw a perfect fractal
topics.fact: Chaos game with 3 vertices, jump halfway -> Sierpinski triangle
topics.hook: Roll a die, jump halfway... 10,000 times
topics.ending: What if you jump 2/3 of the way?

topics.title: How Archimedes trapped pi
topics.fact: Inscribed/circumscribed 96-gons give 3 10/71 < pi < 3 1/7
topics.hook: How did people find pi without calculators?

topics.title: How many handshakes in a room?
topics.fact: n people: n(n-1)/2 handshakes; 10 people = 45
topics.hook: 10 people shake hands once each. How many handshakes?

topics.title: Every angle in a semicircle is 90 degrees
topics.fact: Thales: angle subtended by a diameter is a right angle
topics.hook: Move this point anywhere on the circle...
topics.wow: Angle stays 90 deg; isosceles triangles prove it
topics.ending: What if the point is inside the circle? (angle > 90)

topics.title: Fold paper 42 times to reach the Moon
topics.fact: 0.1 mm x 2^42 = 439,804 km > Moon distance 384,400 km (on average)
topics.hook: How many folds to reach the Moon?
topics.wow: Height counter overtakes the Moon at fold 42
topics.ending: How many folds to reach the Sun? (about 51)

topics.title: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + ... never stops growing
topics.fact: Harmonic series diverges: group terms into blocks each >= 1/2
topics.hook: Do these shrinking pieces add to a finite number?

topics.title: The number 27 takes a wild ride
topics.fact: Collatz: 27 reaches 1 after 111 steps, peaking at 9232
topics.hook: Halve if even, 3n+1 if odd. Start at 27...
topics.wow: Trajectory graph spikes to 9232 then falls to 1

topics.title: Rule of 72: when your money doubles
topics.fact: Doubling time ~ 72 / rate%; 8% -> ~9 years (exact 9.006)
topics.hook: How long does money take to double at 8%?

topics.title: x% of y = y% of x
topics.hook: What is 8% of 50, in your head?

topics.fact: Unit fractions tile a whole bar
topics.hook: Can three different unit fractions make exactly 1?
topics.ending: Find x and y: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/x + 1/y = 1 (one answer: 6 and 12)

topics.title: Why negative x negative is positive
topics.fact: Multiplying by -1 is a 180 deg rotation on the number line; two rotations = 360
topics.hook: Why is -2 x -3 = +6?
topics.wow: Arrow rotates twice and comes home

topics.title: The staircase paradox: is sqrt2 = 2?
topics.fact: Staircase length stays 2 though it approaches the diagonal sqrt2 = 1.414...
topics.hook: Make the steps smaller and smaller... is the diagonal 2?
topics.wow: Length counter stays 2 while the shape converges
topics.ending: Why is this not a proof? (length is not continuous under this limit)

topics.title: Why 7 is the most common dice total
topics.fact: Two dice: 6 of 36 outcomes sum to 7
topics.hook: Roll two dice. Which total is most likely?
topics.ending: Which totals are least likely? (2 and 12, 1/36)

topics.title: Sunflowers use the golden angle
topics.fact: Seeds at 137.5 deg increments pack with no gaps (golden angle = 360/phi^2)
topics.hook: Why do sunflower seeds form spirals?
topics.wow: Changing the angle slightly ruins the packing
topics.ending: Count the spirals: which numbers appear? (Fibonacci)

topics.title: Cubes add up to a perfect square
topics.wow: Cubes flatten into a square of side 1+2+3+4 = 10 -> 100

topics.title: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circle
topics.fact: Inscribed angle theorem
topics.hook: Move a point on a circle: what stays the same?
topics.wow: Angle at centre = 2x inscribed angle as point moves
topics.ending: Which theorem says all angles in a semicircle are 90?

topics.title: Primes form lines in a spiral
topics.fact: Ulam spiral shows diagonal clusters (e.g. n^2 - n + 41 primes for n=1..40)
topics.hook: Write numbers in a spiral and circle the primes...
topics.ending: Why do some diagonals have no primes?
